The original always calls OpenRouter's address and the public status pages of GitHub and Cloudflare, so the copy that produced these cases reads OPENAI_BASE_URL, OPSPILOT_GITHUB_STATUS_URL, and OPSPILOT_CLOUDFLARE_STATUS_URL first and falls back to those addresses, a one-line change in the model factory and two in the status tool, and the cases point the status pages to the replay.
